sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, currently top of the table with 22 points from 10 games, host Alsager Town at home on Saturday 3 October (KO 15:00). Despite their league-leading position, Sandbach have recently suffered a loss, though their underlying record shows seven wins from their last ten matches. They then travel away to face Cheadle Heath Nomads on Saturday 10 October (KO 15:00) in what will be a chance to build momentum against a struggling side.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town (20 points) face a trip to Dawley Town on Saturday 3 October, while title contenders AFC Bridgnorth, Wolverhampton Casuals, and Eccleshall all play that same day—Bridgnorth host Eccleshall in a direct top-four clash, Casuals visit Wednesfield Community, and Eccleshall's home fixture offers a strong opportunity to gain ground. Bilston Town (5th, 17 points) host Foley Meir at home. Lower down, Shawbury United, on a run of five consecutive defeats, visit Barnton; Crewe host Allscott Heath; Cheadle Heath Nomads travel to Sandbach; Widnes Town (bottom, 2 points) visit Brereton Social; and Market Drayton Town (on mixed form) host New Mills. The midweek fixture on Wednesday 7 October sees Brereton Social (struggling with recent losses) host Wednesfield Community at home. By Saturday 10 October, Stafford Town face Wednesfield Community at home while chasing Sandbach's lead, Bilston Town host Crewe, Allscott Heath entertain Brereton Social, Barnton visit Dawley Town, Telford Town travel to New Mills, Market Drayton Town host Widnes Town, and Alsager Town face Shawbury United—a busy week of fixtures across all four match-days.
